rationale: Every artifact use of claim C-AUTH-010 accurately reflects the FAA's framing of the lower-level learned-algorithm traceability problem, as described in the 'Roadmap for Artificial Intelligence Safety Assurance, Version I'. The artifacts consistently include explicit qualifications, such as 'FAA framing,' 'not a claim that all conventional traceability fails,' and 'conventional system/software/hardware assurance remains part of the surrounding system,' directly preserving the claim's scope and limitations and addressing the challenge to avoid overstatement.
